decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks including a high-capacity internal frame pack (High Sierra), a hydration pack (Gelindo), and a replica NATO rucksack. However, the ZOMAKE 20L Ultra Lightweight Hiking Backpack stood out as the most compelling option due to its exceptionally high review count and positive rating at a very accessible price point. While the High Sierra 70L is a high-quality serious hiking pack, for general day-use and travel, the ZOMAKE offers the best utility and value in the current selection.
